'''Charles Woodbridge Hatcher''' (born June 15, 1958)<ref>{{cite news |title=Charlie Hatcher |website=LegiStorm |access-date=August 6, 2026 |url=https://www.legistorm.com/person/bio/477071/Charles_W_Hatcher.html}}</ref> is an American dairy farmer who is the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] nominee for {{ushr|TN|5}} in the [[2026 United States House of Representatives elections|2026 general election]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Charlie Hatcher aims to bring 'common sense' to Washington |date=August 5, 2026 |access-date=August 6, 2026 |website=Williamson Herald |first=Macy |last=Joyce |url=https://www.williamsonherald.com/news/local_news/charlie-hatcher-aims-to-bring-common-sense-to-washington/article_aa36a755-93a9-4ce6-90c4-8b42e7d23686.html}}</ref> He defeated incumbent U.S. representative [[Andy Ogles]] in the Republican primary in an [[Upset (competition)|upset]] race. He previously served as the commissioner of the [[Tennessee Department of Agriculture]] from 2019 to 2025.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/rep-andy-ogles-loses-republican-primary-tennessee-rcna591185 |title=Rep. Andy Ogles loses his Republican primary in Tennessee |work=NBC News |date=August 6, 2026 |access-date=August 6, 2026 |first=Ben |last=Kamisar}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Charlie Hatcher shares family history at Franklin Noon Rotary |first=Macy |last=Joyce |website=Williamson Herald |date=July 16, 2026 |access-date=August 6, 2026 |url=https://www.williamsonherald.com/news/local_news/charlie-hatcher-shares-family-history-at-franklin-noon-rotary/article_92e1cb67-35fa-4349-b9c4-01404947e309.html}}</ref>

Hatcher graduated with a [[Bachelor of Science]] in animal science from [[Middle Tennessee State University]] in 1980, and as a [[Doctor of Veterinary Medicine]] from [[University of Tennessee, Knoxville]] in 1984.<ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Charlie Hatcher, Tennessee's Commissioner of Agriculture |website=Economic Club of Nashville |date=April 5, 2022 |access-date=August 6, 2026 |url=https://econclubnashville.org/events-test/dr-charlie-hatcher-tennessees-commissioner-of-agriculture/}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Outstanding in Their Field: Charlie Hatcher |website=University of Tennessee Institute of Agriculture |date=July 23, 2024 |access-date=August 6, 2026 |url=https://utia.tennessee.edu/spotlights/charlie-hatcher/}}</ref>
